content: Certainly. Barbara Aranda-Naranjo serves as the Director of the HIV/AIDS Bureau within the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) under the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. She is based in Rockville, Maryland, USA, and oversees the Global HIV/AIDS Program. Edson C. Araujo is a Health Economist affiliated with the Health, Nutrition, and Population Human Development Network at The World Bank, located in Washington, D.C., USA. Rebecca Bailey leads the Health Workforce Development Team at CapacityPlus, a program under IntraHealth International, headquartered in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, USA. Jean Barry is a Nurse Consultant working with the International Council of Nurses, based in Geneva, Switzerland. Milliard Derbew Beyene is an Associate Professor of Surgery at the College of Health Sciences, Addis Ababa University, Ethiopia. He is also affiliated with the Medical Education Partnership Initiative (MEPI) in Ethiopia. Margaret Brewinski-Isaacs is part of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, working within the HIV/AIDS Bureau of the Health Resources and Services Administration. She is based in Rockville, Maryland, USA, and contributes to the Global HIV/AIDS Program. Agneta Bridges holds the position of Secretary General at the International Confederation of Midwives, headquartered in The Hague, Netherlands. Eric Dean Buch is a faculty member at the University of Pretoria's Faculty of Health Sciences, located in Pretoria, South Africa. Francisco De Campos serves as a Coordinator at the Federal University of Minas Gerais in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. Ian Couper is the Director of the Centre for Rural Health and the Head of the Division of Rural Health within the Department of Family Medicine at the Faculty of Health Sciences, University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg, South Africa. Lola Dare is the Chief Executive Officer of the Centre for Health Sciences Training, Research, and Development (CHESTRAD), based in Ibadan, Nigeria. Fatoumata Binta T. Diallo is the World Health Organization (WHO) Representative at the WHO Country Office in Bamako, Mali. Seble Frehywot is an Associate Professor specializing in Health Policy and Global Health at The George Washington University in Washington, D.C., USA. David Gordon is a Visiting Professor at the World Federation for Medical Education, affiliated with the University of Copenhagen in Denmark. Carolyn Hall is a Nursing Coordinator at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, located at 200 Independence Avenue Southwest, Washington, D.C., USA. Keith Holmes is a Programme Specialist in the Section for Technical and Vocational Education and Training within the Division for Basic to Higher Education and Learning (ED/BHL) at UNESCO, Paris, France. Jehu Iputo is the Director of the School of Medicine at Walter Sisulu University in Mthatha, South Africa. Yojiro Ishii is a Senior Advisor at the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), based in Tokyo, Japan. Masamine Jimba is a Professor and Chair of the Department of Community and Global Health at the Graduate School of Medicine, University of Tokyo, Japan. Peter Johnson is the Director of Global Learning at JHPIEGO, located in Baltimore, Maryland, USA. David A. Knapp is based in Washington, D.C., USA. Kate Tulenko is the Deputy Director of CapacityPlus and the Director of IntraHealth International, headquartered in Washington, D.C., USA. Leana Uys is the Dean of the School of Nursing at the University of KwaZulu-Natal in Durban, South Africa. Yianna Vovides is a Visiting Assistant Professor and the Communication Cluster Lead at the MEPI Coordinating Center, affiliated with the Communication, Culture, and Technology Program at Georgetown University in Washington, D.C., USA. Walid Abubaker is a Regional Adviser for Health Systems and Services Development at WHO/EMRO. Diona Avocksouma is a Programme Manager for Human Resources for Health at WHO/AFRO. Gulin Gedik is the WHO Team Leader for Human Resources for Health at WHO/WPRO. Silvina Malvarez is a Regional Adviser for Nursing and Allied Health Personnel Development at AMRO/PAHO. Galina Perfilieva is a Programme Manager for Human Resources for Health at WHO/EURO. Budihardja Singgih is a Regional Adviser for Human Resources for Health within the Health Systems Department at WHO/SEARO. Ding Yang is affiliated with the Health Human Resources Development Center at the Ministry of Health, a WHO Collaborating Centre for Human Resources for Health, based in Beijing, China. Mario Dal Poz is the Coordinator for Human Resources for Health within the Department of Health Systems Policies and Workforce at WHO Headquarters. Carmen Dolea is a Technical Officer for Human Resources for Health in the Department of Health Systems Policies and Workforce at WHO Headquarters. Régine Guin is a Team Assistant in the Human Resources for Health Department at WHO Headquarters. Mwansa Nkowane is a Technical Officer in the Human Resources for Health Department at WHO Headquarters. Willem Van Lerberghe is the Director of the Department of Health Systems Policies and Workforce at WHO Headquarters. Erica Wheeler is a Technical Officer in the Human Resources for Health Department at WHO Headquarters.
